# Release Contract

## Purpose

Define what must be true before a release candidate can be cut.

## Gates

- Conformance ledger has no open VIOLATION rows.
- Every frozen contract's hash matches its SYNC row.
- Release evidence is attached to the tag.

proposals.title: Allow a release cut with OPEN-PINNED rows
proposals.why: Two rows are pinned on an upstream fix that will not land before the cut.
tradeoffs: Weakens the gate unless the pin has an expiry
evidence: Upstream issue is dated after the cut
Both rows have a named owner
